title: Multifamily complex - 3D modeling
description: This project was developed and modeled based on the existing site conditions and the client’s preliminary layout sketches. A detailed terrain model was created, along with two multi-family residential buildings and several townhouses. Special attention was given to accuracy and detailing, allowing the client to clearly visualize how the project would look in reality.

title: Sample of Construction Set for the 2-Story Residential Project
description: This contains some drawings from a complete set for a two-storey residential building in Florida. Proposals were made for a plan and a 3D view of the house. Following this, all the necessary documentation was developed and submitted.
The model and drawings were created in Revit, along with the automatic specifications and details.

title: Dialysis Center for a Medical Center 2022
description: The project entails the development of a standalone facility that encompasses 40 dialysis stations, comprising 30 Hemodialysis stations and 10 Peritoneal Dialysis stations.

The Hemodialysis Center is designed as a cutting edge establishment, strategically planned to cater to the increasing demand for dialysis services within the community. Its primary objective is to offer patients a comfortable, convenient, and secure environment for receiving dialysis treatment.

title: Private Residential Mansion 2021
description: Large-scale private residential project involving the preparation of architectural construction documents. Drawings were produced in AutoCAD with focus on accuracy, organized layering, and buildable detailing. Due to confidentiality agreements, only limited excerpts of the documentation are displayed.

title: ID House
description: This living space is designed as a warm and calming family area, defined by natural wood finishes that create a sense of comfort and balance. The TV feature wall uses vertical wooden panels as a clean focal point, enhancing visual height and spatial order. Integrated display niches with soft lighting add subtle depth. Neutral-toned furniture and a round wooden coffee table support a relaxed layout, while indoor greenery and natural daylight strengthen the connection between the interior and nature.

title: Plan Digitization: PDF Redraw to CAD + GIS/Google Earth Alignment
description: Client provided legacy PDF plan sheets. Our team recreated the full plan in CAD and rebuilt all key linework and annotations for a clean, editable drawing set. We then tied the CAD file to real-world coordinates using coordinate control, aligning the work to mapping/imagery for field-accurate placement. Final deliverables included georeferenced CAD files and a KMZ for Google Earth visualization and coordination.

title: Real Estate Site Selection & Zoning Overlay Analysis
role: Real Estate Site Selection & Zoning Overlay Analysis
description: Created GIS overlays for real estate site selection by combining parcels, zoning, utilities, roads, and environmental layers. Built buffer and constraint analyses to screen candidate sites and produced clean, client-ready maps for development decisions. Established a repeatable workflow so new properties could be evaluated quickly. Tools: ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, Excel. Experience supporting real estate and land-use planning projects.
